svg.title: Why the latest candidate is enough

g.text: (a) The hand-over chain at the junction W13

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Read left to right: L leaves W13 (L1); X enters W13 (X1) and leaves (X2); M enters (M2) and leaves (M3);

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: N enters (N3). Every link is an edge SCP keeps.

g.text: S[W13] = [L1, X2, M3, N4]. Between two consecutive

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: leavers of W13, someone must have entered it (here X1,

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: then M2). That entering move got an edge from the

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: previous leaver, and its own AGV's type-1 chain leads to

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: the next leaver. So L1 reaches X2 and X2 reaches M3, and

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: one edge M3 → N3 is enough.

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: (b) Corner case: the latest candidate is the target's own AGV

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: A separate tiny plan on four places u, v, w, x: Y leaves v at t = 1; Z enters v (Z1), leaves to w (Z2) and

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: comes back (Z3). For Z3, S[v] = [Y1, Z2]: the search lands on Z2, AGV Z itself.

g.text: Why the latest candidate is enough (Theorem 3)

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: Every move that leaves a place is ordered after every earlier move that left it, through the AGVs that entered in between. So a target only needs an edge from the most recent leaver;

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: edges from older leavers (red, added by CP) are implied.
